findings.title: Fix for NPE is incomplete: sibling getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference a possibly-null model
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() was changed to guard against modelSupplier.get() returning null (line 274-275), but the three overloaded getSubGroupsStream methods right above it (lines 255-256, 261-262, 267-268) still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly without checking for null. Since modelSupplier.get() can legitimately return null when the backing group was concurrently deleted (which is exactly the scenario this PR is fixing), these methods remain susceptible to the same NullPointerException the PR claims to fix. The fix should be applied consistently to all call sites that dereference modelSupplier.get().

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount() now silently returns null instead of failing or throwing, changing the method contract
findings.body: Previously getSubGroupsCount() delegated to getGroupModel().getSubGroupsCount() which threw an NPE on concurrent deletion. The fix now returns null when the model can't be resolved. GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount() is used elsewhere (e.g. GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount, which calls representation.setSubGroupCount(group.getSubGroupsCount())) without a null check; depending on how callers consume this boxed Long (e.g. unboxing to a primitive, or serializing to a non-nullable representation field), this could introduce a new NPE downstream or silently report an incorrect/misleading subgroup count instead of surfacing the real condition (the group was deleted mid-operation).

findings.title: New concurrency test does not wait for background thread before asserting, making the test unreliable
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti(), a background Thread is started to repeatedly call groups().groups(...) while the main thread deletes groups. After setting deletedAll.set(true) at line 155, the test immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty at line 157 without joining the background thread. The background thread may still be mid-iteration (e.g. in the middle of an HTTP call) when the assertion runs, so an exception that occurs just after the check will never be observed, and the test can pass even though the bug it's meant to catch actually occurred. The test should join() the thread (with a timeout) before asserting on caughtExceptions.

findings.title: New regression test may not exercise the fixed getSubGroupsCount()/getSubGroupsStream() code paths
findings.body: The new test calls managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true) with briefRepresentation=true. Brief representations typically skip populating subGroupCount/attributes, so this call may never invoke GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount() or the other getSubGroupsStream overloads that are the actual subject of the NPE fix. As written, the test may pass regardless of whether the underlying bug is fixed, providing false confidence in the regression coverage.

findings.title: Unrelated dead-code removal bundled into an NPE bugfix PR
findings.body: This PR removes the private helper method groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement from GroupUtils, which is unrelated to the stated purpose of the PR (fixing an NPE on concurrent group access). Mixing unrelated cleanup with a targeted bug fix makes the change harder to review and bisect, and there's no explanation in the PR description for why this method is being removed or confirmation that it isn't still needed/referenced elsewhere.
